description:
Annotations and runtime helpers for mods built on Polyphon, the shared mixin engine for Songs
        of Syx: @Mixin, @Inject, @Overwrite, @ModifyReturn, @ModifyArgs, @ModifyVariable,
        @ModifyConstant, @Redirect, @InjectAt, @Local, plus Shadow, InstanceState, State,
        Cancellation and ConsumerLog.
        Consumers depend on this with 'provided' scope; at runtime the classes come from the Polyphon
        mod the player has enabled.
